title: Procurement Onramp: Safety Hub (automated attestation, dynamic risk tiers, insurance offsets)
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Problem: Enterprise buying cycles are slowed by manual security questionnaires, bespoke contract clauses, and unclear insurance/price offsets. Goal: Deliver a self-serve "Safety Hub" inside the vendor portal that combines automated attestation, document evidence upload, dynamic risk scoring, and insurance-offset suggestions tied to contract templates and pricing bundles. Scope: (1) SOC2 / key control attestation flows with JSON-schema driven question sets; (2) automated evidence extractor for PDFs and spreadsheets; (3) risk-tier calculation engine with deterministic mapping to MRPs (minimum required protections), insurance offset recommendations, and suggested contract clauses; (4) UI patterns for self-serve reviewers and manual escalation; (5) telemetry + KPI dashboard for conversion/time-to-onboard metrics. Out of scope for this ticket: enterprise-only legal negotiations and HSM/KMS integration work (tracked separately).
acceptance_criteria: Self-serve attestation wizard available in vendor portal for SOC2-lite + SOC2-full question sets
Evidence upload accepts PDF/CSV/ZIP; system extracts metadata and flags missing controls in >=80% of seeded test cases
Automated risk-tier output (Low/Medium/High) produced in <3s for standard payloads and persisted to vendor profile
Insurance-offset calculator provides a recommended credit percentage and corresponding contract clause for sales to apply
Admin reviewer UI shows attestation history, extracted evidence snippets, and a one-click escalate-to-legal action
End-to-end telemetry: time-to-complete, abandon rate, manual review rate; baseline instrumented and dashboarded
Privacy & security checklist met and handoff ticket created for full security review before release
tasks: Define JSON-schema for SOC2-lite attestation (PM + Security)
Prototype evidence extraction pipeline (ENG: OCR + heuristics)
Design reviewer UI flows and escalate path (DES)
Implement risk-tier mapping rules and insurance offset heuristics (PM + ENG)
Integrate contract template generator with suggested clauses (Legal + PM)
Create telemetry events and dashboard (Platform Analytics)
Draft rollout plan and support runbook for manual review queue
risks_and_tradeoffs: Automated extraction accuracy vs time-to-market: we will ship with a heuristics-first extractor and schedule accuracy improvements in a follow-up sprint
Conservative risk tiers reduce false negatives but increase manual reviews; decided to bias towards safety (more manual review) for first release
Insurance offset logic is advisory (sales-facing) rather than automatically applied to pricing until legal approves automated clause insertion
Surface-level attestation may not satisfy all customers; offer 'request full review' path that routes to enterprise onboarding team
open_questions: What exact evidence types do our top 10 enterprise customers require beyond SOC2 artifacts? (PM to interview sales ops)
Do we allow vendors to reuse existing SOC2 reports as bundled evidence or require per-tenant attestations?
What SLA should manual review teams commit to for each risk tier? (target: <5 business days for Low, <3 days for Medium, <1 day for High)?
